{{Quote|We've heard rumblings about a Sith cult operating some kind of deep space research installation in the same area. They call themselves "the Unmasked."|[[Jonas Balkar]]|<ref name="TOR:R4A" />}}
A '''research station''' in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] was operated by the [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] known as [[the Unmasked]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:R4A" /> The station was built after the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] discovered a fragment of the [[Mass Shadow Generator/Legends|Mass Shadow Generator]] that [[Battle of Malachor|destroyed]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malachor V]]. The station was then used by the Unmasked to rebuild the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]].<ref name="TOR:TUADE" /> Eventually, the Mass Shadow Generator was destroyed when the [[Eternal Alliance]] [[Mission to the R-4 anomaly|attacked]] the research station and defeated the cult.<ref name="TOR:R4A" />
